weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，何不趁今天為浪漫之旅做好準備？目前的星耀排列讓您與那個特別的人建立關係變得輕而易舉。無論是為伴侶準備一頓溫馨的晚餐，還是與某個吸引您的人安排約會，都要把握機會！不要讓害羞或自我懷疑的情緒阻礙您。如果您是單身，請記得用美好的事物犒賞自己，讓自己沉浸在愛中。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, why not set the stage for a romantic escape today? The current planetary alignments make it a breeze to bond with that special someone. Whether it's whipping up a cozy dinner for your partner or arranging a date with someone intriguing, seize the opportunity! Don't let any feelings of shyness or self-doubt hold you back. If you're flying solo, remember to shower yourself with love by treating yourself to something delightful.
aries.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，今天您可能會因為有人做事慢吞吞而感到越來越沮喪。「然而，必須認識到，這種觀點可能不公平。每個人都有自己的節奏，有時候給予他們所需的空間至關重要。如果您感覺自己脾氣快要爆發，請花一點時間深呼吸，練習一下耐心。
taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, you might find your frustration rising if someone is slow to complete a task. Patience isn't typically your forte, and you might lean towards the mindset of "if you want it done right, do it yourself." However, it's important to recognize that this perspective can be unfair. Everyone has their own rhythm, and sometimes it's crucial to allow them the space they need. If you feel your temper flaring, take a moment to breathe deeply and practice some patience.
taurus.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，今天您可能會在接受回饋意見時感到為難。雖然這對任何人來說都可能具有挑戰性，但請記住，您的觀點扮演著至關重要的角色。不要將批評視為對個人的冒犯，而是考慮其中可能蘊含的教訓。如果您能認可批評的價值，不妨把握機會學習與成長。不過，如果意見似乎完全不合理，您可以大方地不予理會。
gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, you may struggle with receiving feedback. While it can be challenging for anyone, remember that your viewpoint plays a crucial role. Instead of perceiving criticism as a personal affront, consider the potential lessons it holds. Embrace the chance to learn and evolve if you can acknowledge its merit. However, if the feedback seems completely off-base, feel free to disregard it.
gemini.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

cancer.horoscope: 巨蟹座，今天在面對您的理想主義傾向時，請謹慎行事。這個特質是您最大的優勢之一，能激發您的浪漫與創造力，但請記住，過度理想化可能會導致陷阱。即使現實與您的夢想不符，也務必正視現實。這個世界可能並不總是符合您對完美的想像。如果感覺有什麼不對勁，請相信您的直覺，因為直覺通常很準確。
cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, tread carefully when it comes to your idealistic tendencies. This trait is one of your greatest strengths, fueling your romantic and creative spirit, but remember that excess can lead to pitfalls. It's crucial to acknowledge reality, even if it doesn't align with your dreams. The world may not always match your vision of perfection. If something seems amiss, trust your gut feelings—they're likely spot on.
cancer.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

leo.horoscope: 獅子座，今天您可能會渴望擁有一些個人空間。雖然您在社交場合中如魚得水，但一定要撥出一些時間獨處。不妨找個安靜的角落工作，或者乾脆關上門一段時間。如果您有想逃離的衝動，不妨開車兜風，讓自己放鬆一下。請記住，感到煩躁可能是該從喧囂中抽身出來的訊號。
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you might find yourself craving a bit of personal space. While you thrive in social settings, it's essential to carve out some time for solitude. Consider finding a quiet corner to work or simply close your door for a while. If you feel the urge to escape, take a drive to clear your mind. Remember, feeling irritable can be a sign that it's time to step back from the hustle and bustle.
leo.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，如果您最近覺得與最親近的人的關係有點不對勁，不妨反思一下您對他們的期望。花點時間評估您對他人的要求——這些要求合理嗎？難道您對他們的要求與對自己的要求一樣高，即使他們跟不上您的步伐？與這些人進行坦誠的對話，可能會讓您深入瞭解他們的感受。
virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, if your relationships with those closest to you have been feeling a bit off lately, it may be worth reflecting on your expectations of them. Take a moment to evaluate the demands you place on others—are they reasonable? Could it be that you hold them to the same standards you uphold yourself, even if they can't quite keep pace? Engaging in an open conversation with these individuals could provide valuable insights into their feelings.

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，今天是與您心愛之人共度浪漫時光的完美機會。在工作與生活的日常忙碌中，要找到共度的美好時光可能很不容易。如果您不主動安排一些特別的活動，可能要過一段時間才會再次有這樣的機會。所以，主動出擊，著手安排這些計畫吧！如果您是單身，不妨考慮安排一次約會，或者如果可以的話，與朋友共度一段美好時光。
libra.horoscope_en: Today, Libra, it’s a perfect opportunity to carve out some romantic moments with your beloved. Amidst the daily hustle and bustle of work and life, finding quality time together can be a challenge. If you don’t take the initiative to schedule something special, it might be a while before you get that chance again. So, take charge and set those plans in motion! If you’re flying solo, think about organizing a date or enjoying some time with a friend, if you can.

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，今天不妨採取悠閒的態度。宇宙能量顯示，匆忙行事對您沒有好處；相反，這可能會導致錯誤或一堆未完成的任務。建立待辦事項清單，並穩步逐一處理每項事項。請記住，即使您沒有完成所有事項，您所完成事項的品質也會脫穎而出。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, Scorpio, embrace a laid-back approach. The cosmic energies suggest that hurrying won't serve you well; instead, it may lead to errors or a pile of incomplete tasks. Create a to-do list and tackle each item steadily, one by one. Remember, even if you don't check off everything, the quality of what you do complete will shine.

sagittarius.horoscope: 射手座，現在可能是反思您目前人生處境的好時機。您現在的生活是否與您為自己設想的現實相符？如果是的話，太棒了！這是一項了不起的成就。如果沒有，也別氣餒；許多人發現自己與最初的期望相去甚遠。重要的是要明確闡述目標，並列出實現這些目標所需的行動。請記住，這是您的旅程，由您來規劃自己的路線。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Sagittarius, it might be a good moment to reflect on your current position in life. Are you living the reality you envisioned for yourself? If you are, well done! That's a significant achievement. If not, don't be discouraged; many find themselves far from their initial expectations. The important thing is to articulate clear goals and outline the actions required to achieve them. Remember, this is your journey, and it's up to you to chart your course.

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，如果您今天感到煩躁和疲倦，這可能是因為您對自己施加了過大的壓力。重新評估您對自己的標準會有幫助。問問自己，您是否會對親友抱持同樣的期望。如果答案是否定的，那麼現在是時候調整您的生活，讓它更符合您自己的需求。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, if you're experiencing irritability and fatigue today, it could stem from the excessive pressure you've been placing on yourself. It would be beneficial to reassess the standards you hold for yourself. Ask yourself if you would impose the same expectations on your loved ones. If the answer is no, then it's time to adjust your life to better align with your own needs.
capricorn.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

aquarius.horoscope: 水瓶座，請花點時間思考一下，您正花多少時間在生命中最重要的人身上。如果您發現自己把不成比例的時間分配給工作、朋友或伴侶，也許是時候重新評估這種不平衡的現象了。不妨考慮以視覺方式呈現您最近的時間分配情況。如果您發現某個領域明顯蓋過了其他領域，請優先考慮與那些較少關注的領域重新建立連結。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Aquarius, take a moment to reflect on how much time you're dedicating to those who matter most in your life. If you find that your hours are disproportionately allocated to work, friends, or your partner, it may be time to reassess this imbalance. Consider crafting a visual representation of your time distribution recently. If you notice that one area significantly overshadows the others, prioritize reconnecting with those in the lesser categories.

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，今天如果您的伴侶渴望投入自己的興趣，您可能會想退一步。將「緩慢而穩定」的箴言視為您的指導原則。營造一種鼓勵放慢步調的氛圍。與伴侶分享您的想法與渴望；畢竟，他們無法讀懂您的心思。清楚的溝通將大大降低產生誤會的可能性。
pisces.horoscope_en: Today, Pisces, if your partner is eager to dive into their passions, you might feel the urge to take a step back. Embrace the mantra "slow and steady" as your guiding principle. Foster a setting that encourages a more relaxed pace. Share your thoughts and desires with your partner; after all, they can't read your mind. Clear communication will significantly reduce the chances of any confusion.
